title: Binary field power sum
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and positive $\ell$, given a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$, a vector $\gamma\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, and a seed vector $r\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$, define the length-$\ell$ binary vector obtained by summing, over $i=0,\ldots,n-1$, the scalar multiple of the coordinate vector representing $r^{i+1}$ modulo the certified irreducible polynomial, with scalar $\gamma_i$.
hypotheses_covered: a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ is given
caveat: The exact coordinate representation and modular power operation are defined upstream but not described in the supplied definitions.
